notes: input.urlPath is the direct function argument, NOT a full URL or the output of a URL parser. A WHATWG parser can remove dot segments before the function sees them.
expected.resolvedPath is a matching manifest file path or JSON null. Invalid and unresolved requests return null, not exceptions.

Decode percent encoding exactly once. Repeated slashes and dot segments normalize; any dot-dot segment, malformed encoding, invalid UTF-8, NUL or backslash is rejected before SPA fallback. Trailing slash remains significant.
